title: land's undelivered work-rows warning says the next sync delivers them, instead of warning on every landing
goal: SP-aoiqmnc6 retrospective: 6 of the sprint's 10 landings printed 'landed with no work rows on origin/main (undelivered) ... a session end left the store unpushed', and each time the next kbgit.py sync committed the query log store with those rows (origin/main holds the BG-73wc55ew work sidecar). The warning reads as a fault the orchestrator must act on. A land whose worker session ended just before says that the next sync delivers the rows, and warns only when a sync has run since without them.

run:
import sys
t=open('_tools/bl_land.py',encoding='utf-8').read()
ok='next sync' in t;print('the undelivered warning names the next sync:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
